title: Persist-rejection poison state is not pinned (current() is None is vacuous)
description: python/tests/timing/test_time_sync.py:752: in test_provision_persist_hook_rejects_scheduled_awaitable the only state assertion is verifier.current() is None, which passes even if _poison_after_persistence_failure (provisioning.py:426) is disabled — a virgin verifier's __current is None either way (mutant-verified). The established poison pin in this suite is the floor channel: evaluate_epoch_floor(FLOOR, None, verifier=verifier).provision_status is ProvisionEpochStatus.PERSISTENCE_FAILED (cf. :1792-1795). Also add the non-commitment pin verifier.minimum_record_version == 0 (sibling OSError test asserts it at :685).
close_reason: Added the missing pins to test_provision_persist_hook_rejects_scheduled_awaitable: verifier.minimum_record_version == 0 (non-commitment; kills commit-before-persist reordering) and evaluate_epoch_floor(FLOOR, None, verifier=verifier).provision_status is ProvisionEpochStatus.PERSISTENCE_FAILED (poison-revocation via the floor channel). Mutant-verified load-bearing: disabling install-path _poison_after_persistence_failure fails all 3 persist cases at the new assert (non-poisoned verifier returns MISSING, never PERSISTENCE_FAILED). 907 timing+sync tests pass; ruff/mypy clean. Follow-ups filed: P2 (pin the tracker-consumed _floor_result_locked branch via EpochFloorAuthority.current(), the free-function branch is the weaker channel) and P4 (comment disambiguation) via discovered-from.
